pr_changes.title: feat: cross-Analysis shared per-evaluation state in FactorGraphModel
pr_changes.api_changes:
All changes are additive and backward compatible — no removals or renames.

- Added `Analysis.shared_state_from(instance) -> None`: an opt-in hook (default returns `None`) that computes a per-evaluation object shared across a `FactorGraphModel`'s factors. The per-evaluation, cross-factor sibling of `modify_before_fit`.
- `Analysis.log_likelihood_function` (and the `AnalysisFactor` / `PriorFactor` / `HierarchicalFactor` variants) gain an optional `shared=None` keyword argument. Existing analyses that do not declare it keep working because `FactorGraphModel` forwards `shared` only when a factor opts in.

See full details below.

pr_changes.title: fix(nss): chunked algo.init follow-up to #1303
pr_changes.api_changes:
No public-API changes. The existing `af.NSS(chunk_size=...)` kwarg (added by #1303) gains coverage of the init path that previously OOMed before reaching the configuration log line. New private module `autofit.non_linear.search.nest.nss._chunked_nss` is an implementation detail (`_`-prefixed); only `af.NSS._fit` imports it.

`af.NSS._fit` now chooses between the local builder and upstream `blackjax.nss(...)` based on the chunk_size threshold. Default `chunk_size=None` continues to call `_blackjax.nss(...)` bit-for-bit.

See full details below.

pr_changes.title: feat(nss): chunk_size kwarg for inversion-heavy A100 likelihoods
pr_changes.api_changes:
`af.NSS.__init__` gains an optional `chunk_size: Optional[int] = None` kwarg. When unset, behaviour is bit-identical to the previous version. When set and below `num_delete`, the internal `blackjax.nss(update_strategy=...)` is swapped to a chunked variant that uses `jax.lax.map(batch_size=chunk_size)` instead of `jax.vmap` inside the inner MCMC kernel.

New module `autofit.non_linear.search.nest.nss._chunked_update` exposes `make_chunked_update_strategy(chunk_size)` for advanced callers who want the underlying factory directly.

See full details below.

pr_changes.title: docs: raw-flux latent guides + workspace config updates
pr_changes.scripts_changed:
- `config/latent.yaml` — Add `total_lens_flux`, `total_lensed_source_flux`, `total_source_flux` (all `true`) to the workspace overrides; reflow the comment block to explain the raw / µJy / dimensionless grouping; add `total_galaxy_0_flux: false` as an explicit cross-library silencer (the autogalaxy library default leaks into autolens's conf node).
- `scripts/guides/units/flux.py` — New "Latent Variables: Total Flux Directly from the Fit" section. Documents that `latent/samples.csv` now ships raw-flux columns out of the box, explains the units (same as `dataset.data.array`), and demos converting raw flux → µJy in post via `ab_mag_via_flux_from` / `flux_mujy_via_ab_mag_from`. Closes with a pointer to enabling the `_mujy` latents via workspace config + `magzero=` on the analysis (Euclid pipeline pattern).
- `scripts/guides/results/latent_variables.py` — Catalogue section restructured from 5 entries to 8, grouped into raw-flux / µJy / dimensionless. Updated the "All five default to false" claim to reflect the new "raw default-on, µJy default-off" split. Updated the "Toggling Latents" section and the model-fit `magzero` paragraph to describe the NaN+warning soft-fail behaviour rather than the old `ValueError`. Updated the "extra column on top of five library defaults" line to 8.
